text: {"lessons":["The account fell substantially before recovering, so I should judge decisions over a longer horizon while keeping risk within a level I can tolerate.","My sale of Stock A at a large loss is a reminder not to let my purchase price or the discomfort of losses dictate whether I hold or sell.","After adding to four stocks in Period 10, I should check position sizes and preserve enough cash; any trades should follow a clear allocation plan, not recent account movements."]}
